The welcome email, before anyone gets it

Rendered from emails/welcome/copy.json on 2026-09-13. Nothing has been sent. The automation is written and switched off. Edit the copy file, run node emails/welcome/build.mjs, and this page rebuilds with it.

DRAFT — FOUNDER TO EDIT

The note below is a draft and should be rewritten in the founder’s own voice.

Nobody is mailed until note.status is APPROVED, the postal address is set, and the automation is switched on, which are three separate decisions. The list at the bottom says where each one stands.

How it renders

The real HTML, in three frames. Scroll inside any of them.

The fourth frame is the real dark treatment with its media query forced on, so it is the same bytes Apple Mail would render rather than a mock-up of them. Gmail is the one thing no preview can show: it ignores that block entirely and runs its own inversion over the light palette, which is what the light palette is chosen to survive.

In an inbox

A subject line is only ever read in a list, beside a sender name, with the preheader trailing off the end of the row. The sender name is the half that usually decides the open.

  1. Suraj from bingd. I built bingd. Tell me what you think. — Hit reply and it comes straight to me. I read every one. recommended
  2. Suraj from bingd. Thanks for trying bingd. — Hit reply and it comes straight to me. I read every one.
  3. Suraj from bingd. A note from the person who made bingd. — Hit reply and it comes straight to me. I read every one.

Suraj from bingd. reads as a person. bingd. reads as a service, and this email's whole claim is that a person wrote it.

Subject and preheader

Subject · recommended

I built bingd. Tell me what you think.

It asks a question, which is the one thing a subject line can do that makes replying feel like the obvious response rather than an extra step.

Alternative

Thanks for trying bingd.

Alternative

A note from the person who made bingd.

Preheader · recommended

Hit reply and it comes straight to me. I read every one.

The grey line after the subject. Second of three places the reply invitation appears before anybody scrolls.

Alternative

A few things worth trying, and an inbox I actually read.

Where every link and instruction goes

A directly deep-linkable   I an instruction inside the app, with no link, whose labels are checked against the app’s source   D not currently practical, and refused by the build.

CardClassDestinationWhat receives it
founderProfile A https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan /u/* is in appPaths; app/u/[username].tsx renders the profile with FollowControl (label Follow) in its action row. Following a public account is approved at once, so it counts for Group Picks immediately. Without the app: web/dist/u.html resolves the display name and avatar under the profiles_read policy and offers the install row plus Open in bingd.
founderTitle A https://bingd.app/title/d752c0e8-9376-4aa7-bd71-57a11c8d6cfa /title/* is in appPaths and app/title/[id].tsx receives the id. Without the app: web/dist/title.html reads media_items, which is world-readable, and shows the title's name, year and poster before the install row.
inviteFriends I In the app: Profile → Invite friends InviteFriendsButton on the reader's own Profile tab mints their personal invite link and opens the share sheet. Redeeming a personal link makes both follow edges approved whatever either account's privacy (20260912000200_an_invitation_is_a_connection_on_both_sides.sql), which is what 'you follow each other straight away' rests on. Needs: None. Every signed-in account has the button on its own profile.
groupPicks I In the app: For you → Group Picks A chip on the For you tab opening GroupPicksSheet: pick who is watching and it finds movies you can all agree on. Needs: At least one approved follow. With none the sheet says 'Nobody to watch with yet'. The card says 'it works with anyone you follow, me included', and the Follow me card above it supplies one.

Invite friends and Group Picks have no link that lands on them: one lives on the Profile tab, the other is a chip on the For you tab with no route. So their cards say where to tap and carry no button, rather than a button that opens the wrong screen.

Plain text

Generated from the same copy, never hand-maintained. A message with no text part is a spam signal, and a hand-written one stops matching the HTML on the second edit. 

{{greeting}}

Thanks for giving bingd. a go. I am Suraj, and right now I am the whole
team, so this really is me writing.

I built it because I could never say whether a movie was a four or a
four and a half. I can always tell you which of two I liked more,
though, and answer that enough times and you end up with a list that is
actually yours.

It is early, so you will find rough edges. It also gets much better once
one friend you talk about movies with is on it.

If something is confusing, if you love something, or if the thing you
went looking for is not there, just hit reply. It comes straight to me
and I read every one.

Suraj
Founder, bingd.

P.S. My number one is The Wolf of Wall Street, and people keep telling
me that is a red flag. Rank it and tell me I am wrong.
See it on bingd.: https://bingd.app/title/d752c0e8-9376-4aa7-bd71-57a11c8d6cfa

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Three things worth trying

FOLLOW ME
It puts one person in your feed straight away, and I would like to see
what you are watching.
https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan

BRING ONE FRIEND IN
bingd. is better with somebody you already talk about movies with. Tap
Profile, then Invite friends, and send them the link. When they join,
you follow each other straight away.

TRY GROUP PICKS TONIGHT
On the For you tab, tap Group Picks and choose who is watching. It finds
movies you can all agree on, and it works with anyone you follow, me
included.

Whichever of those you try, tell me how it went. Replies come straight
to me.

bingd. is made by Suraj Kandukuri.
[POSTAL ADDRESS - FOUNDER TO SUPPLY]

Still yours to decide

  1. Rewrite the note, then approve it. note.status is "DRAFT - FOUNDER TO EDIT". Set it to APPROVED in copy.json when the words are yours. The worker mails nobody but a canary until then. Keep a reply invitation: it is why the email exists.
  2. Postal address. Not set, so the worker refuses the cohort. A commercial email carries a physical mailing address; there is no company, so it is one you are willing to publish, usually a PO box or a virtual mailbox.
  3. Send from bingd.app. Replies go to suraj@bingd.app, which Cloudflare Email Routing receives. Sending as that address needs bingd.app added and verified in Resend (its DKIM record, the send subdomain, and a DMARC record). Until then a test send can use --from "Suraj from bingd. <suraj@auth.bingd.app>".
  4. A Resend key of its own. Sending access, restricted to bingd.app, named for this email. Never the key named Supabase: that one is the sign-in code relay.
  5. The P.S. title. It names your number one at the time of writing. Swap the id in targets.json founderTitle if that has changed, or set postscript to null.

Not sent to anybody. Automation written and disabled. One email, one copy file, and every link and instruction in it checked against the app.
